data/scripts/europe_story.inc:
@ England chapter one: Oak's field study. Both NPCs leave travel unrestricted.
EuropeStory_Aide::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 2, EuropeStory_Complete
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 1, EuropeStory_Report
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Offer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeStory_Decline
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 1
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Accepted
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_Report::
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_RIVAL_OXFORD, EuropeStory_Reward
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Progress
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_Decline::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Decline
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_Reward::
	checkitemspace ITEM_SOOTHE_BELL, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeStory_BagFull
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Reward
	giveitem ITEM_SOOTHE_BELL, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 2
EuropeStory_Complete::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Complete
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_BagFull::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_BagFull
EuropeStory_End::
	release
	end

EuropeStory_Rival::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 0, EuropeStory_NotStarted
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_RIVAL_OXFORD, EuropeStory_RivalDone
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_OLIVER, EuropeStory_CheckAlice
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_MeetOliver
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_CheckAlice::
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_ALICE, EuropeStory_RivalReady
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_MeetAlice
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_RivalReady::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_BattleOffer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeStory_BattleDecline
	trainerbattle_single TRAINER_EUROPE_RIVAL_OXFORD, EuropeStory_Text_BattleIntro, EuropeStory_Text_BattleLose
EuropeStory_RivalDone::
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 2, EuropeStory_RivalComplete
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_Return
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_RivalComplete::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_RivalComplete
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_NotStarted::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_NotStarted
	goto EuropeStory_End
EuropeStory_BattleDecline::
	msgbox EuropeStory_Text_BattleDecline
	goto EuropeStory_End

EuropeStory_Text_Offer::
	.string "OAK asked us to study what makes a\n"
	.string "route safe for people and POKEMON.\p"
	.string "Start with our meadow trainers,\n"
	.string "then meet your rival in OXFORD.\p"
	.string "Will you join the field study?$"
EuropeStory_Text_Accepted::
	.string "Thank you! Battle OLIVER in the\n"
	.string "meadow and ALICE on OXFORD TRAIL.\p"
	.string "Then meet {RIVAL} in OXFORD.\n"
	.string "Your rival is helping us, too!\p"
	.string "Win that match, then report here.\n"
	.string "Earlier trail wins count, too.$"
EuropeStory_Text_Progress::
	.string "Our study follows your team's bond.\p"
	.string "Beat OLIVER and ALICE, then meet\n"
	.string "{RIVAL} in OXFORD's square.\p"
	.string "After your rival match, return here.\n"
	.string "The clinic can heal your team.$"
EuropeStory_Text_Decline::
	.string "No hurry! I will be here when you\n"
	.string "want to join the field study.$"
EuropeStory_Text_NotStarted::
	.string "{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}! OAK sent\n"
	.string "me to meet traveling trainers.\p"
	.string "Talk to his aide in LONDON's square.\n"
	.string "Then we'll compare our teams!$"
EuropeStory_Text_MeetOliver::
	.string "{RIVAL}: First, try OLIVER's match\n"
	.string "in ENGLISH MEADOW, south of here.\p"
	.string "He'll help you get ready for us!$"
EuropeStory_Text_MeetAlice::
	.string "{RIVAL}: You beat OLIVER! Now meet\n"
	.string "ALICE on OXFORD TRAIL to the south.\p"
	.string "Come back after that match!$"
EuropeStory_Text_BattleOffer::
	.string "{RIVAL}: Both trail matches won!\n"
	.string "Let's show OAK what we've learned.\p"
	.string "My PIDGEY and EEVEE are ready.\n"
	.string "Shall we battle?$"
EuropeStory_Text_BattleDecline::
	.string "{RIVAL}: Sure, take your time.\n"
	.string "The clinic is just over there.$"
EuropeStory_Text_BattleIntro::
	.string "Our partners have come a long way!$"
EuropeStory_Text_BattleLose::
	.string "You've earned it! Let's send OAK\n"
	.string "a report through his LONDON aide.$"
EuropeStory_Text_Return::
	.string "{RIVAL}: Great match! Our results\n"
	.string "are ready for OAK's field study.\p"
	.string "Report to his aide in LONDON.\n"
	.string "Walk south, or take the train.$"
EuropeStory_Text_Reward::
	.string "Your rival sent a glowing report!\n"
	.string "OAK will be pleased with your work.\p"
	.string "A team's bond grows with its journey.\n"
	.string "Here is a SOOTHE BELL to help!$"
EuropeStory_Text_Complete::
	.string "OAK's ENGLAND field study is done!\p"
	.string "Let a partner hold the SOOTHE BELL.\n"
	.string "It helps friendship grow faster.\p"
	.string "ELLIS awaits at OXFORD GYM.\n"
	.string "Look north of the town square!$"
EuropeStory_Text_RivalComplete::
	.string "{RIVAL}: OAK received our report!\n"
	.string "Try ELLIS at OXFORD GYM next!$"
EuropeStory_Text_BagFull::
	.string "Your report is ready for OAK!\n"
	.string "Your BAG's ITEMS pocket is full.\p"
	.string "Make room and come back here.\n"
	.string "I'll keep your SOOTHE BELL safe.$"
data/scripts/europe_france_story.inc:
@ France chapter one: either-order field observations, then a reviewed report.
EuropeFrance_Celine::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 6, EuropeFrance_Complete
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 5, EuropeFrance_Reward
	goto_if_ne VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 0, EuropeFrance_Progress
	goto_if_unset FLAG_BADGE01_GET, EuropeFrance_FirstBadge
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Offer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeFrance_Decline
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 1
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Accepted
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_FirstBadge::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_FirstBadge
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_Decline::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Decline
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_Progress::
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 2, EuropeFrance_NeedForest
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 3, EuropeFrance_NeedGardens
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 4, EuropeFrance_NeedReview
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_BothSites
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_NeedForest::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_NeedForest
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_NeedGardens::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_NeedGardens
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_NeedReview::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_NeedReview
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_Reward::
	checkitemspace ITEM_MIRACLE_SEED, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeFrance_BagFull
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Reward
	giveitem ITEM_MIRACLE_SEED, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 6
EuropeFrance_Complete::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Complete
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_BagFull::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_BagFull
EuropeFrance_End::
	release
	end

EuropeFrance_Remy::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 0, EuropeFrance_NotStarted
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 6, EuropeFrance_RemyComplete
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 5, EuropeFrance_ReturnReport
	goto_if_ne VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 4, EuropeFrance_Progress
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Review
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 5
EuropeFrance_ReturnReport::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_ReturnReport
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_NotStarted::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_NotStarted
	goto EuropeFrance_End
EuropeFrance_RemyComplete::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_RemyComplete
	goto EuropeFrance_End

EuropeFrance_Gardens::
	lockall
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Gardens
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 0, EuropeFrance_MarkerInactive
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 1, EuropeFrance_RecordGardens
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 3, EuropeFrance_RecordBoth
	goto EuropeFrance_MarkerRecorded
EuropeFrance_RecordGardens::
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 2
	goto EuropeFrance_NoteSaved
EuropeFrance_Forest::
	lockall
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_Forest
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 0, EuropeFrance_MarkerInactive
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 1, EuropeFrance_RecordForest
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 2, EuropeFrance_RecordBoth
	goto EuropeFrance_MarkerRecorded
EuropeFrance_RecordForest::
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 3
	goto EuropeFrance_NoteSaved
EuropeFrance_RecordBoth::
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_FRANCE_STORY, 4
EuropeFrance_NoteSaved::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_NoteSaved
	releaseall
	end
EuropeFrance_MarkerRecorded::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_MarkerRecorded
	releaseall
	end
EuropeFrance_MarkerInactive::
	msgbox EuropeFrance_Text_MarkerInactive
	releaseall
	end

EuropeFrance_Text_Offer::
	.string "I'm CELINE, a botanist. Your badge\n"
	.string "shows you can care for a team.\p"
	.string "Our gardens and forests welcome\n"
	.string "different POKEMON. Let's study why!\p"
	.string "Will you help with our garden survey?$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Accepted::
	.string "Read the two study markers beside\n"
	.string "the main paths, in either order.\p"
	.string "One is in FRENCH GARDENS. The other\n"
	.string "is in CHANTILLY FOREST's clearing.\p"
	.string "Then meet REMY in CHANTILLY's square.\n"
	.string "Bring his reviewed report to me.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_FirstBadge::
	.string "I'm CELINE. I study the gardens\n"
	.string "and forests of FRANCE.\p"
	.string "Earn your first badge at OXFORD GYM,\n"
	.string "then help with our field survey!$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Decline::
	.string "Come back when you're ready.\n"
	.string "There is always more to observe!$"
EuropeFrance_Text_BothSites::
	.string "Read both study markers beside the\n"
	.string "paths through the French routes.\p"
	.string "FRENCH GARDENS is north of PARIS.\n"
	.string "CHANTILLY FOREST lies beyond it.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_NeedForest::
	.string "Your garden notes are recorded.\p"
	.string "Find the study marker in the\n"
	.string "middle of CHANTILLY FOREST.\p"
	.string "Then visit REMY in CHANTILLY.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_NeedGardens::
	.string "Your forest notes are recorded.\p"
	.string "Read the FRENCH GARDENS study marker\n"
	.string "beside the path north of PARIS.\p"
	.string "Then visit REMY in CHANTILLY.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_NeedReview::
	.string "Both sites are recorded! Take your\n"
	.string "notes to REMY in CHANTILLY's square.\p"
	.string "He waits west of the town guide.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_NotStarted::
	.string "I'm REMY, a gardener. CELINE in\n"
	.string "PARIS is organizing a field survey.\p"
	.string "Speak to her west of the city guide.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Review::
	.string "REMY: The garden and forest offer\n"
	.string "different kinds of shelter. The\p"
	.string "survey helps us protect both.\n"
	.string "Restless POKEMON in PARIS may be\p"
	.string "missing a quiet place too. Your\n"
	.string "report is ready for CELINE.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_ReturnReport::
	.string "Take the reviewed report to CELINE\n"
	.string "in PARIS. Walk south or use the train.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Reward::
	.string "CELINE: REMY's report is excellent!\n"
	.string "Thank you for visiting both sites.\p"
	.string "This MIRACLE SEED is for your team.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Complete::
	.string "The French garden survey is complete!\p"
	.string "Let a partner hold MIRACLE SEED\n"
	.string "to strengthen its GRASS-type moves.\p"
	.string "MARINE awaits at CHANTILLY GYM.\n"
	.string "Look north of the town square!$"
EuropeFrance_Text_RemyComplete::
	.string "REMY: CELINE received your report.\n"
	.string "Try MARINE at CHANTILLY GYM next!$"
EuropeFrance_Text_BagFull::
	.string "Your survey is complete, but your\n"
	.string "BAG's ITEMS pocket is full.\p"
	.string "Make room and return to CELINE.\n"
	.string "Your MIRACLE SEED will be waiting!$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Gardens::
	.string "FRENCH GARDENS STUDY MARKER\p"
	.string "Light reaches the low plants here.\n"
	.string "ODDISH shelters among the leaves.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_Forest::
	.string "CHANTILLY FOREST STUDY MARKER\p"
	.string "Trees shelter the plants below.\n"
	.string "CATERPIE hides among their leaves.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_NoteSaved::
	.string "You recorded this site's notes!\n"
	.string "REMY in CHANTILLY reviews both.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_MarkerRecorded::
	.string "This site's notes are already\n"
	.string "recorded in your survey.$"
EuropeFrance_Text_MarkerInactive::
	.string "Ask CELINE in PARIS about the survey.$"
data/scripts/europe_germany_story.inc:
@ German signal-repair delivery. Mission cargo is tracked outside the Bag.
EuropeGermany_Lena::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 3, EuropeGermany_Complete
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 2, EuropeGermany_Reward
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 1, EuropeGermany_Directions
	goto_if_unset FLAG_BADGE01_GET, EuropeGermany_Badges
	goto_if_unset FLAG_BADGE02_GET, EuropeGermany_Badges
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Offer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeGermany_Decline
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 1
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Accepted
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_Directions::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Directions
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_Badges::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Badges
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_Decline::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Decline
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_Reward::
	checkitemspace ITEM_MAGNET, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeGermany_Full
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Reward
	giveitem ITEM_MAGNET, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 3
EuropeGermany_Complete::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Complete
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_Full::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Full
EuropeGermany_End::
	release
	end

EuropeGermany_Karl::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 0, EuropeGermany_NotStarted
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 3, EuropeGermany_KarlComplete
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 2, EuropeGermany_Return
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Delivered
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 2
EuropeGermany_Return::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_Return
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_NotStarted::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_NotStarted
	goto EuropeGermany_End
EuropeGermany_KarlComplete::
	msgbox EuropeGermany_Text_KarlComplete
	goto EuropeGermany_End

EuropeGermany_Text_Offer::
	.string "I'm LENA, a signal engineer.\n"
	.string "Two badges! You know these routes.\p"
	.string "KARL needs parts for a woodland\n"
	.string "trail beacon near ORANIENBURG.\p"
	.string "Will you deliver a repair parcel?$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Accepted::
	.string "You packed LENA's repair parcel!\n"
	.string "Mission cargo stays outside the BAG.\p"
	.string "Find KARL west of ORANIENBURG's\n"
	.string "town guide, then bring his report.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Directions::
	.string "KARL waits west of ORANIENBURG's\n"
	.string "town guide with the damaged beacon.\p"
	.string "Take the train, or walk north\n"
	.string "through BERLIN WOODLAND and HAVEL.\p"
	.string "Your repair parcel is packed.\n"
	.string "Bring his report back to me!$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Badges::
	.string "I need a courier for a trail repair.\n"
	.string "First, earn two GYM badges.\p"
	.string "Visit ELLIS in OXFORD, then MARINE\n"
	.string "in CHANTILLY after their studies.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Decline::
	.string "No hurry. The main paths are open.\n"
	.string "Come back when you're ready!$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Reward::
	.string "LENA: KARL restored the beacon!\n"
	.string "Reliable signals help companions\p"
	.string "find safe paths. A faulty relay at\n"
	.string "the REICHSTAG needs attention too.\p"
	.string "This MAGNET is for your team.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Complete::
	.string "Let a partner hold the MAGNET\n"
	.string "to boost its ELECTRIC-type moves.\p"
	.string "Our repaired beacon helps travelers\n"
	.string "find the trail in fading light.\p"
	.string "Try CONRAD at ORANIENBURG GYM.\n"
	.string "Look north of the town square!$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Full::
	.string "Your report is delivered, but your\n"
	.string "BAG's ITEMS pocket is full.\p"
	.string "Make room and speak to me again.\n"
	.string "I'll keep your MAGNET safe.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Delivered::
	.string "KARL: The repair parts from LENA!\n"
	.string "Now I can fix this trail beacon.\p"
	.string "A fresh coil and a tight connection\n"
	.string "should bring its light back.\p"
	.string "There! The beacon is working again.\n"
	.string "You received KARL's repair report.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_Return::
	.string "Take my report to LENA in BERLIN.\n"
	.string "She waits west of the city guide.\p"
	.string "Use the train, or walk south along\n"
	.string "HAVEL TRAIL and BERLIN WOODLAND.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_NotStarted::
	.string "I'm KARL. I maintain trail beacons.\n"
	.string "This one needs a replacement coil.\p"
	.string "LENA in BERLIN is preparing parts.\n"
	.string "Ask her west of the city guide.$"

EuropeGermany_Text_KarlComplete::
	.string "KARL: LENA received my report.\n"
	.string "The beacon is ready for the trail.\p"
	.string "CONRAD awaits at our GYM!$"
